annotations.text:
A — Quiet Editorial
Dark, serif headings (Newsreader) + plain sans body, hairline dividers, muted sage-green accent instead of blue. Feels like a sports-desk publication.

B — Technical Grid
Dark, monospace for all scores/times/status, faint column rules, cyan accent + bracketed status tags. Scoreboard precision.

C — Soft Paper
Light mode, single sans family, rows become soft bordered cards with pill statuses, forest-green accent. Calmer, more app-like than spreadsheet-like.
